links.outcome: Clinician burnout and after-hours documentation time before and after 30 days of ambient AI scribe use
links.effect: Burnout fell from 51.9% to 38.8% (OR 0.26; 95% CI 0.13-0.54). After-hours documentation time improved by a mean (SE) of 0.90 (0.19) hours.
links.quote: After 30 days with the ambient AI scribe, the proportion of participants experiencing burnout decreased significantly from 51.9% to 38.8% (odds ratio, 0.26; 95% CI, 0.13-0.54).

screen.reason: Evaluates the overall implementation and impact of an ambient AI scribe on clinician burnout and administrative burden across multiple health systems, without specifically testing an operational safeguard or deployment practice variation.
